answer_2.quote: We compute the recall, precision, and Micro-F1 metrics individually for both hallucinatory and non-hallucinatory categories. Additionally, we assess the overall performance by measuring the average Macro-F1 scores at the claim and segment levels.

answer_3.quote: we instruct our chosen MLLM (GPT-4V or Gemini) to assess each claim's hallucinatory potential.

answer_4.quote: We allocate the dataset uniformly across three annotators with graduate-level qualifications for independent categorization.
answer_4.guideline: Our annotation criteria evaluate whether image-to-text output conflicts with the input image or world knowledge and whether text-to-image visuals conflict with claims or world knowledge.
